src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Account setup results
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: The possible results of first-run admin creation, admin recovery and closing or reopening a farm account.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Connected app link
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: One person's connection to one outside app, merging every approval they have given it.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Assign flock request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: The request to give a worker access to a flock; it carries the extra confirmation token, which is never printed.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Change own password request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: A signed-in person changing their own password by entering the current one first.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Change sign-in email request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: The request to change a user's sign-in email, with the extra confirmation token.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Change role request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: The request to change a user's role, with the extra confirmation token that every role change needs.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Create user request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: The details for adding a new user: email, name, password and role, with the extra confirmation token.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Password error codes
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: The fixed codes for reasons a password or credential is refused.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Disable user request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: The request to switch off a user's account, with an optional reason recorded in the activity log.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Enable user request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: The request to switch a disabled user's account back on.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Farm sign-in
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: A small record naming the farm a person is signing in to.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Account lifecycle outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Describes the operations that set up, recover, close or reopen a farm account.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Sample user setup outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Lets the demo and test data loader create sample users. Not registered in Production.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: User lookup for other areas
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Describes what other areas of the app may ask about a user, such as who they are and their role.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Accounts feature outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: The list of everything the accounts area offers the web layer: managing users, a person's own profile, flock assignments and sign-in sessions.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Server admin commands outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Describes commands run by someone with direct access to the server, such as setting up or recovering an admin.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Sample user lookups outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Lets the demo and test data loader find existing users. Not registered in Production.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Sign-in still valid check
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Describes the check run on every signed-in request that the person's password and sign-in have not been changed or revoked, and the two-step verification status for owners.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Connected app cleanup outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Describes the routine cleanup of expired connected-app approvals.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Old sign-in cleanup outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Describes deleting expired stay-signed-in tokens.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Sign-in outcome
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: What a correct password leads to: either signed in, or a request for a second code from the authenticator app.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Cleanup result
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: How many expired connected-app records a cleanup removed.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Connected app permissions
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: The list of permissions an outside app can ask for.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Password rules
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: The single set of length limits for new passwords, used when creating a user, resetting a password and changing your own.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Sign-out result
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: The result of cancelling a stay-signed-in token.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Reset two-step request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: The request for an owner to reset another user's two-step verification.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Try again later error
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: The refusal shown once a user has used up the day's allowance of wrong authenticator codes.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Second sign-in code
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: A code from the authenticator app (6 digits) or a recovery code, checked for the right shape.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Second code error codes
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: The fixed reasons a second sign-in code is refused.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Set language request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: A person choosing their preferred language, or clearing it.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Set egg counting unit request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: A person choosing which egg unit their quantity stepper counts in.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Set user password request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: An owner setting another user's password without knowing the old one, the way to handle a forgotten password.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Extra confirmation error codes
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: The fixed reasons an extra-confirmation check is refused.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Extra confirmation grant
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Proof that a person recently re-confirmed their identity; the token is never printed.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Sign-in tokens
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: The pair of tokens given at sign-in, one for short-term access and one to stay signed in; neither is ever printed.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Two-step setup results
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: What comes back when setting up two-step verification: the start of setup, the confirmation with recovery codes, and the error cases.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Unassign flock request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: The request to remove a worker's access to a flock, with the extra confirmation token.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Edit user name request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: The request to change an existing user's display name.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Display name rule
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Tidies a display name by trimming spaces and treating a blank name as no name.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: User profile
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: A person's own profile details.
